title: Getting Laid Off Has a $10,668 Hidden Bill
hook: You planned for the income gap when you lost your job — but 65% of workers have no idea about the $1,778/month health insurance bill that hits immediately.
angle: COBRA health insurance is the invisible financial catastrophe of job loss that nobody prepares for — your employer was silently paying 70% of your premium, and the moment you leave, every dollar becomes yours
audience: Workers in their 30s-50s with employer-sponsored health insurance who have any emergency fund
key_numbers: Employer pays ~70% of premium while employed
$10,668 in COBRA costs during a 6-month family job search
65% of laid-off workers skip COBRA entirely
